```python
def export_csv(rows, columns):
    cols = list(columns)
    seen = set()
    for c in cols:
        if not isinstance(c, str):
            raise ValueError("column names must be strings")
        if c in seen:
            raise ValueError("duplicate column name: %r" % c)
        seen.add(c)

    def encode(value):
        if value is None:
            s = ""
        else:
            s = str(value)
        if any(ch in s for ch in (",", '"', "\r", "\n")):
            return '"' + s.replace('"', '""') + '"'
        return s

    records = [",".join(encode(c) for c in cols)]
    for row in rows:
        records.append(",".join(encode(row.get(c)) for c in cols))
    return "\r\n".join(records) + "\r\n"
```
